description:
### Ultimea 1.4.4 (build 495)

- **Pure Black AMOLED Theme:** Enables pure black AMOLED background and surface colors with light text and controls. Patches Dart AOT dark palette tokens directly in libapp.so, sets pure black splash styling, and bundles pre-rendered high-contrast device input and user icons with zero runtime dependencies.
- **Hide Explorer Tab:** Hides the Explorer/Community tab from the bottom navigation bar and collapses store icons.

### Installation

Enable pre-releases for BadFella Patches in Morphe Manager and refresh Sources. Repatch Ultimea 1.4.4 with dev.3, then install using your existing Manager signing key to preserve app data.
